source_summary: Tall hanging-scroll Chinese landscape with layered misty mountains above, forested cliffs and blue-green rock washes in the middle, a pavilion with seated scholars among dense trees, rocky streambanks, reeds, and a small covered boat at the lower right.

motifs.name: misty_distant_peaks
motifs.description: Soft background mountain silhouettes across the upper third: pale vertical peaks at upper left, center, and upper right emerging through mist behind the darker ridges.
must_preserve: faint ink outlines softened by wash
muted blue-green and brown-gray tonal gradations
mist-veiled edges where peaks fade into the sky
subtle vertical cliff contour lines

motifs.name: upper_forested_cliff
motifs.description: Large upper-right cliff mass with rounded summit, steep face, and scattered dark tree-dot foliage along ridge crests and ledges.
must_preserve: dense black dotting along the ridgelines
thin wrinkled contour lines running down the cliff face
blue-green mineral wash over brown ink structure
small exposed ocher rock ledges
soft mist transition at the lower base

motifs.name: left_curving_mountain
motifs.description: Sweeping left and central mountain slope that curves downward like an arch, with layered rock striations, dark shrub clusters, and turquoise-green washes.
must_preserve: arched contour of the slope
fine layered rock linework
dark stippled tree and shrub masses
warm ocher exposed rock patches
blue-green wash pockets on the shaded cliff

motifs.name: valley_hamlet_band
motifs.description: Tiny distant settlement and path at the right middle valley: small roofed structures, pale ground plane, tree line, and low embankment beneath the mountains.
must_preserve: miniature roof geometry and hut outlines
thin vertical tree marks behind the buildings
pale misty clearing around the hamlet
curving dark embankment or path line
delicate scale contrast against the mountains

motifs.name: pavilion_scholars
motifs.description: Open riverside pavilion with tiled thatched roof, railings, steps, columns, interior screens, and seated scholar figures inside.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry and parallel roof strokes
straight wooden columns and railing lattice
seated scholars with robes and small facial linework
interior screen panels and table details
fine platform supports and steps

motifs.name: left_foreground_tree_grove
motifs.description: Dense foreground grove on the lower left with multiple tall trunks, dark leafy canopies, bamboo-like foliage, and partial garden fence elements.
must_preserve: interlaced trunks with pale bark highlights
dense rounded leaf-dot clusters
dark ink bamboo or drooping foliage strokes
fine fence and gate linework at the far left
layered undergrowth and stippled ground texture

motifs.name: right_bamboo_bank
motifs.description: Right-side bank beside the pavilion with bamboo and slender trees, dark brushy foliage, small water edge, and rocky ground.
must_preserve: vertical bamboo culm strokes
short clustered bamboo leaf marks
leaning tree trunks with exposed roots
soft blue-green ground wash
irregular ink-dotted rocks and bank edge

motifs.name: boat_reed_shore
motifs.description: Lower-right waterside motif with a moored covered boat, low shore ledges, reeds, grasses, and small rocks in shallow water.
must_preserve: thin outline of the long narrow boat hull
rectangular canopy roof and support posts
dark reed clusters drawn with quick vertical strokes
stepped muddy shore contours
small scattered rocks and pale water wash

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
